name: Fredric M. Winocur
tagline: Top rated White Collar Crimes attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Fred Winocur is a partner at Landy Leedy McGreevy & Winocur, a criminal defense law firm in Denver, Colorado. Mr. Winocur specializes in defending white-collar and economic crimes in various industries. He represents both individuals and corporate clients in all stages of the investigative and enforcement process. His award-winning criminal defense practice combines white-collar defense with general criminal defense. For years, Fredric Winocur has been a top choice for defense counsel in high-profile matters.

Fred Winocur has experience in all criminal, regulatory, and civil actions, including securities violations, financial fraud, healthcare fraud, mail and wire fraud, environmental crimes, consumer protection violations, and public corruption. To navigate internal and external investigations, he works closely with general counsel, in-house counsel, and corporate executives such as boards of directors.
